svg.title: Permanently Exhausted Pigeon — fillable paint-by-number page
svg.desc: A side-profile pigeon with a pear-shaped body, small round head, short beak and cere, iridescent neck, folded wing, tail, and feet resting on a bed. Full-color library preview; opening the SVG changes paintable regions into a numbered worksheet.
